reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 18 points better, in a game of about 239 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Timberwolves (look-ahead, confidence).
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 94 times in 100, by about 18; most games like this end between 214 and 262 total points.

analyst.text: Minnesota have won five straight without Anthony Edwards, capped by a 133-94 rout of Dallas in which LaMelo Ball and Bones Hyland combined for 46 points. Chicago are on a back-to-back after hosting Atlanta. They have lost eight straight and just lost No. 4 pick Caleb Wilson to a fractured hand for about four to six weeks. The only mental caution for Minnesota is a look-ahead to Portland. The lean is heavily toward the Wolves.
